previewBody: You are seeing content that has not been reviewed yet (status: needs review). Learners do not see it until a named reviewer approves it with a date.
privacyTitle: Your data stays in your browser
privacyBody: Your profile is saved on this device only. We collect only what is needed for professional development and never infer sensitive personal attributes. Every field is optional except current role and target role.
profileLede: Tell us where you are now and where you want to go. Your target role sets the competency levels you need and your gaps.
fCertsHint: Self-declared — not treated as a verified credential.
fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields, then save.
confirmDelete: Your profile and self-declared levels will be removed from this browser. Continue?
vRole: Choose a target role from the list.
compLede: Levels required for your target role compared with your current level. No level is ever granted just for completing a course.
noRoleBody: Required levels and gaps are calculated from the role you are working towards.
noPublishedBody: The competency framework is under professional review. Levels and gaps will appear here as soon as a named reviewer approves the content.
radarNote: Average level of the required competencies in each domain. Undeclared competencies count as zero.
radarTable: Show chart data as a table
domainTableTitle: Target and self-declared level by domain
verifiedNote: Verification comes later through assessments and practical work (Phases 5, 11 and 12).
fwLede: Domain → competency → sub-competency → dimension (knowledge / skill / application / experience) → proficiency level 0 to 5.
noResults: No competencies match. Try another word or choose All domains.
evidenceNote: Each level needs every listed group to be met (any one type inside a group). Course completion alone never raises a level.
rolesLede: Required levels for each role. These are example paths, not the only valid route.
reviewLede: Approve each competency or request changes. Approval needs a reviewer name and a date, and is stored in this browser for export to the repository.
reviewNeedsName: Enter the reviewer name before approving.
reviewOnly: This page is for reviewers and admins. Change the role at the top of the page.
testsLede: In-browser unit tests for this phase's logic: profile validation, level and gap maths, governance, and export/import.
dlgExportHint: Copy the text and save it as a .json file. It contains only your profile and self-declared levels.
dlgImportHint: Paste the JSON text you exported earlier.
eJson: the text is not valid JSON
dlgReviewHint: Attach this text to the next development session to apply the approvals in the repository.
footer: Phase 2 review build · version {v} · Prepared by مدثر سلامه · Original content, not copied from any protected standard or body of knowledge.
